entities.name: Temur Frontier
entities.description: One of the five Clans of Tarkir, a semi-nomadic green-blue-red clan of fierce survivors who admire the dragons' aspect of savagery.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane home to the five clans and the dragons.

entities.name: Yasova Dragonclaw
entities.description: Khan of the Temur in 3279 AR, a willing pawn of Nicol Bolas who ended up surrendering to Atarka.

entities.name: Eshki Dragonclaw
entities.description: The khan who commanded the Temur rebellion against Atarka.

entities.name: Surrak Dragonclaw
entities.description: A khan who bested a bear in single combat, and lost a wrestling match to Eshki.

entities.name: Atarka
entities.description: The dragonlord who leads the dragon brood infesting Temur territory and purged the whisperers.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: A planeswalker who tricked Yasova with false visions and aimed to murder Ugin.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A planeswalker whom Bolas sought to murder and who taught Whispering to the ancestors of the tribe.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker who discovered Yasova was a pawn of Bolas.

entities.name: Whisperers
entities.description: Temur mages and spiritual leaders chosen by the spirits.

entities.name: Dragonclaw
entities.description: The title of the Temur's revered warrior leader.

entities.name: Twice Whisperer
entities.description: The head whisperer chosen by the spirits.

entities.name: Endless Song
entities.description: The energy that suffuses the land and connects all beings, the Temur religion.

entities.name: Qal Sisma
entities.description: Inhospitable mountains where the Temur hunt most of the year.

events.summary: In the original timeline Yasova is tricked into aiding Bolas in murdering Ugin, resulting in the extinction of dragons.
events.quote: was tricked into aiding Bolas in murdering Ugin , resulting in the extinction of dragons.

events.summary: In the current timeline Yasova's efforts instead cause Ugin to slumber, creating more dragons; after failing to unite the khans she appeals to Atarka and feeds her.
events.quote: Yasova was forced to try to appeal to Atarka, the leader of the dragon brood infesting Temur territory

events.summary: Atarka purges the whisperers, stripping the Temur of their identity and reorganizing survivors into a clan dedicated to feeding her.
events.quote: Atarka initiated a purge of the whisperers, fearing their elemental magic

events.summary: Rebellions grow under Atarka's cruel rule and surviving whisperers emerge from hiding to galvanize them.
events.quote: many remaining whisperers emerged from hiding.

events.summary: Rebels and whisperers combine forces to defeat Atarka and the other dragonlords.
events.quote: their combined might led to Atarka's defeat alongside the other dragonlords.

events.summary: After Atarka's fall the Temur resume their spiritual traditions and nomadic life.
events.quote: After the fall of Atarka, the spiritual traditions of the Temur began to be practiced once again, as well as their nomadic way of life.

events.summary: Yasova surrenders to Atarka when Bolas's plans fail.
events.quote: When their plans failed, Yasova had no choice but to surrender to Atarka.

events.summary: Eshki beats Surrak in a wrestling match to prove her right to lead the rebellion.
events.quote: Eshki Dragonclaw commanded the Temur rebellion against Atarka, beating Surrak in a wrestling match to prove her right to lead.
